title: Watermark presence pins are whole-document inequality checks; per-page coverage rests on template construction, not tests
detail: Both presence tests only assert marked ≠ plain anywhere. A future regression watermarking just the cover (e.g. dropping `background: demo-watermark` from the interior `#set page`) still passes both, weakening the every-page acceptance criterion.
recommended_fix: Assert per-page presence: count watermark ExtGState `gs` invocations (the `/ca 0.2509804` object) in the marked render and require ≥ page count, mirroring how the committed PDFs were verified.

title: skip_if_no_typst/typst_available/normalize_metadata helpers duplicated across two test files
detail: The diff copies the typst skip guard, the `available` external, and the `normalize_metadata` external from audit_report_test.gleam. AGENTS.md: extract helpers when logic repeats 2+ places; a skip-policy change now touches two files.
recommended_fix: Move skip_if_no_typst, both externals, and priv_dir into a shared test-support module (e.g. server/test/typst_support.gleam) and import from both test files.
